jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Content Platform
jobs.description: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We own music content ingestion at Spotify, which is how music from labels, distributors and other partners gets onto the platform. We receive industry-standard deliveries, validate them, and turn them into the catalog data that teams across Spotify build on, including lyrics, rights and supply data. As we add new content types and partners, we’re building an ingestion platform that scales without a custom build every time. What You'll Do Build and run the backend services and data pipelines that ingest, validate and process music deliveries from partners, covering audio, metadata, lyrics and new content types Own large parts of the ingestion pipeline and lead technical work as we add video, richer partner data and other new content Make ingestion more reliable, catch data quality problems at the point of entry, and improve the operational tooling around the pipeline Design and evolve APIs and schemas that other teams depend on, keeping contracts stable and backward compatible Help move validation towards real time and make Silk Road a well-documented, self-serve platform Deliver roadmap work, take part in planning, review code, and share on-call Work with Content Ops, operations tooling teams, partner teams and the product teams that build on our content Who You Are You have strong experience building and operating backend services and data pipelines in production

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Content Platform
jobs.description: Content Platform is the foundation of Spotify’s experiences. We ensure our vast catalog of music, podcasts, audiobooks, video, and creator data is trusted, safe, and ready to power innovation across Spotify. Our work spans content governance, platform safety, metadata, and machine learning systems that enable experiences such as Music Quiz , Playlist Mixes , Save to Spotify and SongDNA . Every day, our platform helps teams across Spotify build better products for millions of listeners and creators. As a Principal Product Managers you will own strategy directly. In this role, you’ll shape long-term direction, partner closely with engineering, machine learning, design, and business leaders, and deliver platform capabilities that have company-wide impact. What You'll Do Define and evolve product strategy for your domain using customer insights, data, and long-term platform thinking. Lead complex product initiatives from early discovery through delivery in partnership with engineering, machine learning, data science, and design teams. Partner with machine learning engineers to shape model strategy, training data, evaluation frameworks, and human-in-the-loop systems. Collaborate with stakeholders across Spotify to align priorities, influence roadmaps, and drive platform investments that create lasting value. Make thoughtful product decisions by balancing customer needs, technical complexity, business priorities, and long-term platform health. Champion platform safety, trust, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence as Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow. Help teams prioritize work that delivers the greatest long-term impact while maintaining focus on strategic outcomes. Communicate product vision, strategy, and progress clearly across technical and executive audiences. jobs.title: Video Editor
jobs.description: Superside is looking for a craft-focused, creatively driven Video Editor to help us take our video production to the next level. We’ve already redefined how creative work gets done, video included, by combining world-class talent, smart workflows, and cutting-edge tools. We're continuously rethinking how it’s produced, delivered, and experienced in the creative industry. This role is an opportunity to shape what modern video production looks like: fast, high-quality, collaborative, and deeply creative. If you're excited about experimenting with formats, blending craft with speed, and creating work that inspires teams and delights customers, this is the role for you. What you’ll do: Research trends in digital and social content, with a focus on post-production techniques. Contribute ideas and creative direction on briefs, bringing deep video expertise to every project. Own your editing pipeline from ingest to final delivery, collaborating with creatives, strategists, and marketers along the way. Produce short-form videos that stand out, crafting compelling stories from raw footage with precision and speed. Edit and deliver high-quality content optimized for various digital channels. Continuously raise the creative bar through innovative visual storytelling and editing techniques. What you’ll need to succeed: 2+ years of experience creating high-quality editing preferably with any on-set experience. Proven ability to create high-impact short-form video content, with a strong showreel showcasing storytelling and editing skills. Deep proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe Creative Cloud tools (After Effects a plus). Excellent understanding of content specs, exports, and best practices across digital and social platforms. Strong grasp of narrative structure, pacing, and emotional storytelling. jobs.title: Freelance Writer
jobs.description: Our organization is seeking content writers to create articles and blog posts on a variety of topics. The rate of pay is $20 per 100 words (this comes out to approximately $100 per article or $50 per hour). Some topics you may be asked to write about include the following (you can always turn down a topic if you do not feel comfortable writing about it, however if you have experience or expertise in a specific area, please let us know): Health & beauty Fitness Home Decor Fashion Sports Do it yourself Finance Legal Medical Family/Parenting Relationships Real Estate Restaurants Contracting (plumbing, pool building, remodeling, etc.) These are just some of the more general industries and topics that we cover. Requirements : We ask that all work be completed using a word processor such as Microsoft Word or Open Office A reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines Good communication skills and respond in a timely manner to editorial staff when they ask for updates on tasks, etc Work well as a team member with the rest of our content management and editorial staff Note : Applicants to this job signaled that accessing some writing tasks may require payment.

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.
